relationships.statement: "A person can edit an entry's work and its duration, and the entry shows the escaped edited work and duration." depends on "Starting and stopping a timer records the entry's duration; when an entry shows a running timer and the person stops the timer, the entry shows a duration equal to the elapsed time between starting and stopping, and the timer no longer runs.".
conditions: R2 requires editing an entry's work and duration, and R4 requires the timer to record the entry's duration when stopped
